title: wolfssl_ecdsa.c: ECDSA sign/verify for /dev/crypto2dev
description:
Implement src/providers/wolfssl/wolfssl_ecdsa.c — ECDSA sign and verify for P-256 and P-384.

## Why this exists
DO_SIGN/DO_VERIFY for EC keys return -EOPNOTSUPP today. wc_ecc_sign_hash and wc_ecc_verify_hash are exported by libwolfssl.ko. The sign callback receives a pre-computed digest (not raw message) which is exactly what wc_ecc_sign_hash expects — no intermediate hashing needed.

## Algorithms to register
  'ecdsa-p256' — sign, verify, key_import, key_generate, key_export_public, key_export_private
  'ecdsa-p384' — same

## Shared key context with wolfssl_ecdh.c
  ECDH and ECDSA use the same underlying ecc_key struct and the same key import/export/generate/free logic. Options:
  A. Shared wolfssl_ec_key.h with static helpers; both wolfssl_ecdh.c and wolfssl_ecdsa.c include it
  B. wolfssl_ec.c registers both ecdh-p256 and ecdsa-p256 in one file
  Recommendation: Option A — keeps ECDH agree and ECDSA sign/verify in separate files matching the existing per-algo-family pattern.

## Context struct (same as wolfssl_ecdh.c)
  struct wolfssl_ec_ctx { ecc_key key; WC_RNG rng; int curve_id; u32 key_type; bool rng_inited; bool key_inited; }
  Factor into wolfssl_ec_key.h static helpers used by both files.

## sign implementation
  1. FIPS gate first
  2. Verify key_type is PRIVATE or PAIR
  3. sig_bufsz check: must be >= wc_ecc_sig_size(&ctx->key) (DER-encoded max)
  4. wc_ecc_sign_hash(digest, digest_len, sig, &out_len, &ctx->rng, &ctx->key)
     wc_ecc_sign_hash produces DER-encoded ECDSA signature (r || s in ASN.1 SEQUENCE)
     Returns 0 on success; out_len set to actual DER signature length
  5. *sig_len = out_len

## verify implementation
  1. FIPS gate first
  2. int res = 0;
     ret = wc_ecc_verify_hash(sig, sig_len, digest, digest_len, &res, &ctx->key)
  3. Check BOTH: ret != 0 → wolfCrypt error → -EINVAL; res != 1 → invalid signature → -EBADMSG
  4. Return 0 only if ret == 0 AND res == 1

## key_import, key_generate, key_export, key_free
  Identical to wolfssl_ecdh.c. Share implementation via wolfssl_ec_key.h static helpers.
  key_type for ECDSA sign: PRIVATE or PAIR; verify: PUBLIC or PAIR

## Registration
  Register 'ecdsa-p256' and 'ecdsa-p384' ops structs in wolfssl_provider.c algo_ops[] array

## Tests needed
  tests/userspace/test_ecdsa.c: KEY_IMPORT priv → DO_SIGN → DO_VERIFY → 0
  Tampered sig → DO_VERIFY → -EBADMSG
  Known-answer: ECDSA is non-deterministic (unless RFC 6979) so test verify-only against known vector;
  sign→verify round-trip is the sign KAT
design: Option A chosen: wolfssl_ec_key.h shared header with static inline helpers for key_import/free/generate/export. Avoids duplicate code without introducing a separate object file or cross-module linkage.
